source_note: CELPIP-style writing practice prompts created for study use. Some topics are based on common CELPIP practice themes and official-style formats, but they are not official exam questions.

questions.title: Damaged Appliance Delivery
questions.prompt:
You recently ordered a kitchen appliance online, but when it was delivered to your home, you noticed that it was damaged and could not be used.

Write an email to the company's customer service department in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain what item you ordered and when it was delivered.
- Describe the damage and how it affected you.
- Request a replacement, refund, or another suitable solution.

questions.title: Broken Elevator Complaint
questions.prompt:
The elevator in your apartment building has been out of service for several days, and this has caused difficulties for many residents.

Write an email to your landlord or property manager in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain the problem and how long it has been happening.
- Describe how it has affected you or other residents.
- Ask when the elevator will be repaired and request urgent action.

questions.title: Request for Schedule Change
questions.prompt:
You need to temporarily change your work schedule because of a family responsibility.

Write an email to your manager in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain why you need the schedule change.
- Suggest the temporary schedule you would like to follow.
- Reassure your manager that your work will still be completed properly.

questions.title: Corporate Team-Building Event
questions.prompt:
Your company is organizing a team-building event for employees, and you have been asked to arrange a group activity.

Write an email to a local adventure park in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Introduce yourself and explain the purpose of your email.
- Inquire about the activities they offer for group events.
- Ask about availability, pricing, and any special packages for corporate groups.

questions.title: Missing Grocery Items
questions.prompt:
You ordered groceries online, but several items were missing when the order arrived.

Write an email to the grocery company's customer service department in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain when you placed the order and what was missing.
- Describe any inconvenience this caused.
- Ask for a refund, replacement, or credit for the missing items.

questions.title: Work-from-Home Request
questions.prompt:
Your company currently allows employees to work from home only one day per week, but you would like to request additional work-from-home days.

Write an email to the human resources department in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain your current work situation.
- Give reasons why working from home more often would help you.
- Ask whether the company can approve your request.

questions.title: Assignment Extension
questions.prompt:
You are taking a course, but you have been sick and cannot finish an important assignment by the deadline.

Write an email to your instructor in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain your illness and why you cannot meet the deadline.
- Ask for an extension and suggest a new submission date.
- Thank your instructor and promise to complete the assignment.

questions.title: Noisy Neighbour
questions.prompt:
Your neighbour often plays loud music late at night, and it is affecting your sleep and daily life.

Write an email to your neighbour in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain the noise problem politely.
- Describe how it has affected you.
- Ask your neighbour to reduce the noise during late hours.

questions.title: Hotel Refund Request
questions.prompt:
You recently stayed at a hotel, but your experience was disappointing because the room was not clean and some facilities were not working.

Write an email to the hotel manager in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain when you stayed at the hotel.
- Describe the problems you experienced.
- Request a refund, discount, or another form of compensation.

questions.title: Snow Removal Complaint
questions.prompt:
The roads and sidewalks in your neighbourhood have not been cleared properly after recent heavy snow.

Write an email to your city council or local government office in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

- Explain the snow removal problem in your area.
- Describe why it is dangerous or inconvenient.
- Ask the city to improve snow removal services as soon as possible.

questions.title: Delayed Luggage
questions.prompt:
You recently took an international flight, but your luggage did not arrive with you and has been delayed for several days.

Write an email to the airline's customer service department in about 150-200 words. Your email should include:

questions.title: Unstable Internet Service

questions.title: Birthday Invitation

- Ask your friend to attend and let you know if they can come.

questions.title: Used Car Inquiry

questions.title: Bullying Concern at School

questions.title: Work from Home or Office
